text:
ana: Deploybot flagged RC-3377: SBOM signing service is returning 502 for cosign callbacks and vuln scan shows 1 medium transitive CVE only in arm64 artifacts. Change window closes in ~3h. Options: hold, carve out APAC arm64, or pin arm64 to rc-3370. Thoughts? @sam @security

deploybot: [automated] status=blocked release=rc-3377 reason=sbom_signer_error+vuln_flag details=cosign_502; arm64:CVE-2026-8888 (transitive)

sam: Triage: CVE in debug dependency, low exposure. SBOM signer outage is likely vendor side. I prefer regional carveout for arm64 and continue amd64 canary with tighter metrics.

security: We can accept a short regional carveout if we add: 1) 100% sampling of edge traces for arm64, 2) stricter error budget (0.5% for the canary), and 3) auto-fallback to rc-3370 on any CVE evidence. Require signed SBOM within 4h.

legal: We need a release note line and compliance entry. Draft wording approved: "Arm64 variant excluded from regional canary due to SBOM signer outage and a transitive-vuln flag; amd64 canary proceeds under monitoring. Full rollout blocked until signed SBOM verified."

ana: Plan: apply routing exclude for ap-southeast arm64 now, start amd64-only canary, set timebox 4h for signer recovery. If signer not recovered, pin arm64 to rc-3370. Anyone object?

sam: No objections. I'll create the sampling and alert rules: sig_signer_outage_rc_3377 and vuln_arm64_watch.

deploybot: [automated] routing exclude applied by ana at 5090123490: rule rr-900. fallback to rc-3370 configured fb-900.

deploybot: [automated] canary start: rc-3377 (amd64-only) -> global-canary at 5090123515 rollout_id=r-77ff

ana: Release note published: https://docs.internal/releases/rc-3377-notes "Arm64 excluded from regional canary due to SBOM signer outage and transitive CVE; amd64 canary proceeds under monitoring."

security: Alerts wired to #security and oncall. Timebox 4h (deadline 5090137856). Reopen thread if signer recovers or alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
